summary: Well-structured plan that faithfully implements Option A from the analysis. All 13 tasks are discrete, properly ordered, and have specific acceptance criteria. Technical approach verified against source: Pipeline model extension is backward-compatible, PhaseDependencyGraph.compute_waves() returns the expected structure, and there is a clean insertion point in _run_tier3_implement() for populating wave data. Test strategy is comprehensive with unit, integration, regression, and edge case coverage. Risk assessment identifies the key challenges (side-by-side rendering, terminal width) with concrete mitigations.
